On the floor nearby, a large plastic-wrapped bundle of diapers is visible, along with a black microphone on the desk. (3) The toddler is shown standing in a hallway, gripping and pulling a heavy pack of diapers across the wooden floor. The lighting is warm and domestic, emphasizing a spacious modern apartment interior with dark doorways. (4) The woman is now seated on a grey sofa in a living room, pointing towards a digital QR code overlay. A large pack of diapers sits on a small round side table next to her. (5) Close-up shots focus on the hands of the woman stretching the elastic waistband of a diaper and showing the inner mesh texture against a white background. (6) The toddler is seen playing on a white plastic indoor slide and walking through various rooms of the house, wearing only a diaper and a t-shirt to showcase the product's fit. (7) The video concludes with the woman sitting back on the sofa, smiling and holding a pack of diapers prominently for the camera while pointing to final text overlays.
